items.title: Manuel "Fess" Manetta and Edward "Kid" Ory Interview, 1958-08-26
items.q: So I take Baby in the band. I had my band.

ctx.x: So I take Baby in the band. I had my band. I had 10-piece archery. And I had to show him how we played. I'd take the trumpet and play Panama and all them numbers, you know. Just give them circus boys a swing. We got him down.
We worked pretty good. You never did have to go in the army then and then? Well, no.
